name: 专注甲板
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity minimalist desktop web app compositional concept, 1440x1000
Primary request: Create a simpler redesign option E, focus deck, for the Chinese computer-science learning platform 词元研究所. Keep a restrained science-fiction mainframe character while eliminating dense telemetry, ornamental marks, and repeated framed cards.
Scene/backdrop: full desktop app viewport, no device frame, matte near-black surface.
Subject: a single slim horizontal header, a centered current learning mission with four-step text sequence, and a low three-column course footer for C语言, Python, 数据结构.
Style/medium: polished minimalist product UI, spacecraft flight-plan discipline reduced to clean structure.
Composition/framing: top navigation, large central focus field, one dominant horizontal sequence, ample negative space.
Color palette: charcoal black, cool slate, soft white, one selectable ion-cyan accent active. No red frames.
Constraints: minimal interface; maximum three visual bands; no decorative charts, circular gauges, dense system readouts, nested frames, gradients, huge slogan, floating pill clusters, purple, red, illustration, or watermark.
